summary: Keep (regional park). 164 sites on the park map, 75 seasonal and 89 sold online (Let's Camp; ~54% nightly). C$25-50 + GST (2026), 50 A full service, 28-night max, gates May 1 - Nov 15. Count 71 -> 164; electric 30 -> 50. Not waterfront kept. Pin fine. Google 4.4 (138).
flags: LONG-STAY (local): about 89 of 164 sites (54%) are sold by the night - Let's Camp lists 89 public sites; the park map marks 75 'Seasonal Sites' (loop 1 1-22, 31, 32, 37, 38; loop 5 63-101; nine-ten S sites). Seasonal sites go by a random draw; no wording discourages nightly guests. Over 50% nightly, so no mostly-seasonal line.
SITES: stored count 71 (note prose) -> 164 counted from the park map + Let's Camp. 19 of the 89 bookable sites cap rigs at 18 ft (39, 42-50, B5-B13); 70 take 24-40 ft.

FEES: the C$25 base is the park's 'Non-Electric Tenting' class; Let's Camp offers five of those sites (55, 56, S15A, S15B, S20) to RVs up to 25 ft, so it counts. The cheapest electric night a 23-ft rig fits is C$35 (S12A 15-amp + water, or B1-B4 30-amp no water). The Regional Park Pass price is not posted on the park's pages: fees.entrance not written.
WATERFRONT: 'not waterfront' kept. Avonlea Creek (narrow, under ~30 m) loops round the north campground under continuous tree canopy; the park map puts loop 4 sites 56-61 nearest it. Not upgraded.
